strings.دروس تشطيب البيت في الكويت 4: اعتمد الخا: Home finishing lessons in Kuwait 4: approve materials and samples before delivery
strings.اخترت شكل الصالة واتفقت على نطاق الشغل،: A living-room design and agreed scope are not enough for ordering materials if the only specification is “the colour in the picture”. Lesson four of the Almusaileem series turns selections into a record for the homeowner, supplier and contractor. The aim is to receive the intended material and identify any substitution before installation.
strings.تصميم توضيحي للوحة خامات تضم خشباً مسطحا: Illustrative design of a materials board that includes flat wood, stone, marble and light paint samples
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.

strings.جهّز مخطط الغرف، نطاق العمل المتفق عليه،: Prepare a room plan, agreed scope of work, and photos of items that will remain. By the end of the lesson, you have a schedule of finishes, reference samples, and a list of selections still pending. This step starts early, but some credits await final measurements or technical review. The order of lessons helps you learn; the sequence of actual implementation is determined by your project and its specialists.
strings.سوّ بطاقة واضحة لكل اختيار: Sue clear card for each choice
strings.ابدأ بأسماء ثابتة للغرف: صالة، ديوانية،: Start with the fixed names of the rooms: a hall, a divan, a main room, and a corridor. For each surface type the name of the product, the company, the color code, shine or engraving, then the place of use and the sample number. The word «white» alone is wide, as well as «lightwood substitute". And if the material needs a specific installation direction or distribution of veins, register the desired with a sketch or annotated image.
strings.أضف خانة لحالة القرار: مقترح، بانتظار مر: Add a status check: proposed, pending review, or approved. Type the date of approval and the name of the person responsible for it. Approval of the material is separate from the approval of the supply sizes; your liking of a displayed piece does not confirm that its dimensions are suitable for the wall. Here the contractor reviews the sizes and details before ordering.
strings.شوف العينة في مكانها الحقيقي: See the sample in its real place.
strings.حط عينات اللون بجانب الأرضية والستارة وا: Land the color samples next to the floor, curtain and existing furniture, and review them under the natural light and the lighting you are using.
strings.أن الإضاءة والخامات المحيطة والسطح واللم: Lighting, ambient materials, surface and shine affect the appearance of color. It is recommended that you review an actual sample. The reference is useful for choosing, while the availability of the product and its specifications in Kuwait is reviewed with the supplier.
strings.إذا كان القرار حساسًا، اتفق على نموذج تط: For important decisions, agree on a suitable mock-up with the contractor. Check colour, texture, edges and material junctions as relevant. strings.إذا قال المورد إن الاختيار غير متوفر، اط: If the supplier says that the selection is not available, ask for the alternative's data, sample and reason for proposing it. See its effect on the shape, thickness, edges and care method, and on adjacent items. The specialist vinegar checks the suitability of the system, then the record has been updated before approving the supply. The similarity of the name or image is not enough to prove that producers are performing the same purpose.
